rows.hook: Curative petition dismissed for retired Army officers

The verdict impacts thousands of former officers who served on short-term contracts before seeking pension parity. Indian retail investors have no direct financial exposure or market impact from this judicial decision.

rows.headline: Jefferies warns AI investment cycle may have peaked while raising India allocation to 14%
rows.hook: AI investment cycle may have peaked

Indian retail investors gain from higher foreign institutional interest directed toward domestic equities.

rows.winners_losers: Indian equities gain / global AI supply chain hurt

rows.headline: Chinese e-bike makers expand abroad amid high fuel prices
rows.hook: High fuel costs fuel overseas expansion
